lines.zh: 我贴着沙地快速窜出去。
lines.en: I dart out low over the sand.

lines.zh: 身体压得很扁，几乎贴着地。
lines.en: My body rides almost flat to the ground.
A few steps, then I stop and look up.
My tail whips behind me.
I slip under a stone.
I run along the dry riverbed.
My claws patter on the sand.
I skirt a patch of alluvium.
I bolt to the far side of a dune.
I stop and start, uneasy.
I follow the cracks in the ground.
I lift my head and scent the wind.
I run along the dune's crest.
I stop short, ear twitching.

lines.zh: 我换了个方向，沙被踢起来。
lines.en: I change course, kicking up sand.

lines.zh: 从这块石头跳到下一块。
lines.en: From this stone to the next.
I crouch, eyes moving.
Small body, hidden in the sand tones.

lines.zh: 沙色的皮，贴在干河床上。
lines.en: Sand-coloured skin pressed to the dry riverbed.

lines.zh: 风把我的尾巴吹得动了动。
lines.en: The wind stirs my tail.
I lift my head, then lower it.
The sand is warm here.
The sand is too hot; I shift a foot.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤和沙子一个颜色。
lines.en: My skin is the colour of the sand.

lines.zh: 沙面上只露出我的眼睛。
lines.en: Only my eyes show above the sand.
There ought to be eggs nearby.

lines.zh: 我贴着地爬，肚子都磨亮了。
lines.en: Crawling low, my belly has worn smooth.
I glance left and right.
The slightest sound and I run.
I sink into the sand.
I look up, every muscle tight.
I step back, then stop.
You are so tall; I should back further off.
Lift a foot and I bolt.
Any move from you sets me on edge.
My tongue slips out first.
Your shadow sets me on edge.
I flatten and edge back.

lines.zh: 疼得我整条尾巴弹起来。
lines.en: The pain snaps my whole tail up.
Six health is gone in a single hit.
I'm quietest when stealing eggs.
My body is a little crushed.
When hungry, I steal eggs.
Pressed to the stone, I dare not move.
A piece of my tail is gone.
I can't stop trembling.
I burrow into the sand with only my tail out.
Are those eggs?
I smell egg.
I can smell what is buried in the sand.
I check around first.
I'd bite and run.
You're not watching me, are you?
I'll drag it behind a stone.
That's one mouthful.
That eggshell: I can chew through it.
I'm covered in sand.

lines.zh: 我绕开你的脚，钻进沙里。
lines.en: I slip around your feet and into the sand.
It didn't hurt much, but it frightened me.
Don't step on me.
I hide in a crevice.
I peek out to see if you've gone.
Easy—my bones haven't hardened yet.
One bump and my heart races.

lines.zh: 沙丘后面有同类的味道。
lines.en: A kin's scent behind the dune.
I dart over.
We circle once.
I'll find warm sand.
Under the dune, nobody comes.
I rub against the sand.
Leave the egg-watching to me.
I hid our nest behind the dune.
I snap it up.
I crunch it.
The shell is thin.
I bury it in the sand.
This smells a bit off.
I look up to see if anyone's watching.
Would this trade for an egg?
I'll grab it and run. Don't chase.
A shadow falls on the sand.
There is an egg in the sand; I can smell it.
That thing is too big.
I flatten myself.
I keep low and hunt for eggs.
I'm ready to run.
I've picked my route.
Its steps veer away.
It has not left, and I dare not move.
The sand matches me.

lines.zh: 趁着它转头，我往蛋那边蹭。
lines.en: While it turns its head, I edge toward the eggs.
It looks elsewhere.
I shift an inch.

lines.zh: 我慢慢抬起头，沙子从背上落。
lines.en: I slowly lift my head; sand slides off my back.
I bolt.
Fast.
I tuck my limbs in tight.
I bite its foot.
Small teeth, but sharp.
I let go and run at once.
I bump once and hide.
A bite and run is all I have.
I burrow into the sand.
One bite from me, and it poisons.
I just stole an egg.
I'm still shaking.
That bite carried venom.
You'll feel numb soon.
I crawl out of the sand.
The light here is harsh.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘的缝里钻出来。
lines.en: I slide out of a crack in the dune.
The alluvial plain runs on.
First, find a stone.
A stone gives cover.
I slip under and poke my head out.
I smell eggs in the distance.
Step by step, carefully.
The wind lifts the sand.
I wait for the wind to pass.
This will do.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，贴着河床爬。
lines.en: I flatten and crawl along the riverbed.
The sand bakes and I run in leaps.
I hit the sand and bounce once.
Water fills my mouth; I thrash.

lines.zh: 一支箭把我和沙钉在一起。
lines.en: An arrow pins me to the sand.
Light locks my legs.
Lightning strikes and I stiffen.
